title.zh: MiniMax把OpenAI新Agents API做成开源版，Codex、Claude Code都能接
title.en: MiniMax把OpenAI新Agents API做成开源版，Codex、Claude Code都能接

current_state.zh: MiniMax open-sourced OpenAgentCore, a self-hosted implementation of the OpenAI Agents API that lets developers keep the OpenAI SDK, change only the API endpoint, and run Codex, Claude Code or MiniMax Code as the orchestrating agent backend.
current_state.en: MiniMax open-sourced OpenAgentCore, a self-hosted implementation of the OpenAI Agents API that lets developers keep the OpenAI SDK, change only the API endpoint, and run Codex, Claude Code or MiniMax Code as the orchestrating agent backend.
